claude.rationale: This is structured as a distressed-asset purchase of "substantially all of the assets of the LightSquared LP Entities" (T4 subset) via a Chapter 11 plan, with no definitive APA negotiated or executed with the target and expressly "no committed terms for transfer of the workforce, management, or operating organization." Because the customer-facing spectrum/assets were proposed to cross the boundary while no operational-process transfer terms were set (gap_45=1), and no transitional-services or operating agreement allocating that substrate is documented (gap_mitigated=no). Whether the operating processes (T5) transfer at all is not determinable from the slice, so gap_56 is uncertain; the acquirer is a pre-existing wholly-owned DISH subsidiary formed to bid, so no new legal vehicle swap is coded (T3 null).

grok.rationale: The slice structures a proposed Chapter 11 plan asset sale of substantially all LightSquared LP Entities assets to L-Band, so T4 is coded as transferring as a whole package; it simultaneously states the Proposed APA had not been negotiated or executed and sets out no committed terms for workforce, management, or operating organization (T6 null). No closing-structure evidence documents that customer-facing assets would cross without their producing processes, nor that processes would transfer without the organization, so gap_45 and gap_56 are 0.

openai.rationale: The contemplated plan provided for L-Band to purchase substantially all assets of the LightSquared LP Entities, supporting transfer of the customer-facing asset layer. However, the Proposed APA had neither been negotiated with nor executed by the target, and the filing supplied no committed workforce, management, operating-organization, or process-transfer terms. Because the slice does not document at closing that processes were excluded from the assets or structurally separated from personnel, neither a T4–T5 nor a T5–T6 mismatch is established.
